data.title: Bertucci's
data.extract: Bertucci's is an American chain of Italian restaurants offering pizza and other Italian food, founded by Joey Crugnale in Davis Square, Somerville, Massachusetts, in November 1981. The company expanded rapidly during the 1990s. N.E. Restaurant Co. Inc. bought out Bertucci's in 1998, adopting the Bertucci's Corp. name in 2001. Today, Bertucci's has 11 locations; 9 in Massachusetts, and one each in Delaware and Pennsylvania.
